scope: Human change-set items14/18; optional settings and bridge only

primary_cores.sing-box: Separate signed primary APK per new human instruction. Existing base-library phone evidence is historical; no assumption that the new separate runtime/package/API is accepted.
primary_cores.steer: Read-only owner descriptor0.3.3-dev/API2 lists SOCKS5 protocol but not this authenticated optional-worker bridge's granular TCP/UDP contract. Arm64/x86_64 stages and owner-reported gates do not prove new MCRF signed primary integration. Bridge capabilities remain unknown until primary/engine owner verifies them; no inferred compatibility from a core name.

required_bridge_capabilities.trust: Main maps only actual signed installed primary descriptor/native evidence into Primary(verified=true,capabilities). Pure helper performs no package discovery or install. Existing SingBoxEngine fullNativeConfig=true and Steer protocols:socks5 do not directly declare this granular vocabulary; an owner-verified mapping/native bridge gate is needed, not optimistic synthesis.
required_bridge_capabilities.final_gate: Native primary full-profile check, optional module preflight, explicit confirmed switch, then runtime checks remain mandatory. eligibleForNativeCheck is not switch approval.

duplicates.decision: Keep separate protocol controls. Neither protocol default can be transferred to the other without compatible server evidence.

duplicates.setting: built-in fragment versus custom record fragment
duplicates.decision: Different runtime mechanisms; retain explicit labels and profile priority. Primary owner owns built-in settings; optional TLS page owns record size and group delay.
Do not duplicate on optional pages. Keep with primary transport settings and captured tuning. TLS worker supports system/Mozilla; Xray Mozilla and builtin fragment limitations stay explicit.

unsupported: Xray plus custom TLS fragment/mixedcase combination remains rejected, not implemented
Pinned Xray removed allowInsecure: reject rather than disable certificate verification
Steer full profile/DNS/routes/TUN/native API compatibility is primary owner's validation responsibility

optional_worker_preflight.requiredWorkerCapabilities: Pure requirements union for every worker tag, grouped by xray/tls-core. Xray checks VLESS/UDP and applicable XHTTP/REALITY/MUX; TLS checks record fragment/mixedcase/uTLS/certificate-store only when used.
optional_worker_preflight.workerBlockers: Compare requirements against same-signer descriptors already validated by OptionalCoreProcess.capabilities. Absent module/feature is a blocker; no installation or settings changes occur here.
optional_worker_preflight.final_gate: Empty workerBlockers and eligibleForNativeCheck still require full primary native config validation, each OptionalCoreProcess.check and explicit confirmed switch. Capability declarations never replace real config/runtime checks.

removal_proposals_only.reason: Server-specific; ordinary users rarely tune it and Vision is incompatible

removal_proposals_only.setting: custom fragment size and group delay
removal_proposals_only.proposal: Consider advanced section inside TLS subpage
removal_proposals_only.reason: Network-specific tuning with latency tradeoffs; preserve working defaults and manual overrides

unsafe_certificate_disable: Default remains off in CoreTuningSettings; optional pages add no disable toggle. Explicit global insecure applies only to capable TLS worker; pinned Xray refuses it. Main/primary owner owns confirmation/guard for any unsafe primary setting.
navigation: Main uses OptionalCoreUi.xrayPage()/tlsPage()/page(id) within Settings subpages. Builders open no popup. Legacy view() remains temporary compatibility hook; do not render it together with both pages.
